target_policy: native baseline with required memory coordinate conversion

qualification_pending.worldwarp: Pre-intervention prefix mismatch; current apparent gain is confounded.
qualification_pending.astronex: Raw prefix parity unverified; current pair also has unsupported positional registration.

scene_selection: Retain both original development scenes; add the lowest two SHA256(memory-multiboundary-v2:SCENE) names among remaining batch scenes. No observer/outcome filtering.
evaluator: VIPE, fixed intrinsics and anchor-depth registration, no target-trajectory fitting
primary_interval: first_affected_frame through native exported endpoint, original timestamps
prefix_mismatch_policy: hold remaining pairs for that model; preserve the mismatched result
invalid_registration_policy: position unavailable; retain rotation, validity, and failure counts
split_claim: expanded development; not untouched held-out data
method_change_policy: new version and matched-arm reruns; no outcome-driven edits within this snapshot
artifact_retention: After each arm, exact RGB hash-verified FFV1 can replace newly generated NPZ/PNG frames; all pose, command, memory and score evidence retained.
